title: Shaah ast hussain
body:
Shaah ast hussain
<<MINI>>
(Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deen panah ast hussain) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Sar daad na daad dast dar dast-e-yazeed) x3 haqqa ke bina la illah ast hussain
<<MINI>>
Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deepanah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Sardaaro shehenshaah ay shaahe shaheedan, qaari sare naiza ay waarise quran (kehti hain namazein ab tak sare maidaan) x2
<<MINI>>
suno zindaa hai hussain suno zinda hai hussain
Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deepanah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Azaon namaaze milad-e-mohammed, ye majlis-o-matam abbas ka parcham (kehti hain sabilein kehta hai muharram) x2
<<MINI>>
suno zinda hai hussain suno zinda hai hussain
Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deepanah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ka kaleja halq-e-ali asgher, abbas ke baazu zainab ka khula sar (kehte hain ye tujhse ay shaam ke lashkar) x2
<<MINI>>
suno zinda hai hussain suno zinda hai hussain
Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deepanah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Marqad se nikal kar khud fatema zahra, maqtal ki zameen par deti rahi pehra (khanjar se sina se kehti rahi zahra) x2
<<MINI>>
suno zinda hai hussain suno zinda hai hussain
Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deepanah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Zanjeer-e-sitam ne rasta nahi roka, pehne huwi bairi chalte rahe mawla (kehta hai abhi tak sajjad ka sajda) x2
<<MINI>>
suno zinda hai hussain suno zinda hai hussain
Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deepanah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Adaa ke tamache rukhsaare sakeena, jhalta huwa damaan gharmi ka mahina (kehti thi phuphi se har aik se kehna) x2
<<MINI>>
suno zinda hai hussain suno zinda hai hussain
Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deepanah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Beemare madina woh fatema sughra, darwaaze pe baithi takti hai jo rasta (khud ko yehi kehkar deti hai dilasa) x2
<<MINI>>
suno zinda hai hussain suno zinda hai hussain
Shaah ast hussain badshaah ast hussain, deen ast hussain deepanah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
